content_metadata.description: A step-by-step instructional tutorial video on how to install and use a portable Kodi build on a USB drive.

activities.description: Narrator introduces the tutorial on installing Kodi to a USB drive.
Narrator explains the need for a USB drive.
Narrator demonstrates formatting the USB drive.

Quick cut back to file explorer.

activities.description: Narrator mentions the need for Kodi 16.1.
Narrator opens the Kodi installation file.
Narrator runs the Kodi installation wizard.
Narrator instructs to choose the USB drive as the installation location.
Narrator chooses not to create shortcuts.
Narrator waits for the installation to complete.
Narrator opens the USB drive and locates the Kodi executable file.
Narrator creates a shortcut for the Kodi executable on the desktop.
Narrator adds "-p" in the shortcut target to make Kodi portable.

Making Kodi portable by adding "-p" to the shortcut target.

props.name: File explorer window showing the contents of the USB drive.

Series of quick cuts as the narrator navigates through the setup wizard windows.

activities.description: Narrator opens the portable Kodi application.
Narrator points out the creation of a "portable_data" folder.
Narrator explains the need to delete content from "portable_data" and demonstrates it.
Narrator explains the process of transferring a build to the "portable_data" folder.
Narrator copies a build from his computer to the "portable_data" folder on the USB drive.
Narrator explains the importance of using a high-speed SD card with sufficient storage space.

narrativeProgression.description: Transferring a build from the computer to the "portable_data" folder.

props.name: File explorer windows showing "portable_data" folder and "Kodi Build" folder.
Kodi application with a black background.

scenes.title: Adding Kodi Build to Portable Setup

videoEditingDetails.description: Quick cuts between file explorer windows.
Quick cut to the Kodi application.

activities.description: Narrator opens the portable Kodi application with the build installed.
Narrator points out that the background image is missing as it wasn't transferred.
Narrator explains how to fix the missing background image issue.
Narrator demonstrates changing the background image path to the correct location on the USB drive.
Narrator summarizes the process and emphasizes the portability of the setup.
Narrator demonstrates copying the shortcut to the desktop for easy access.
Narrator opens Kodi from the desktop shortcut, showing the build is functioning correctly.
Narrator concludes the tutorial, encourages subscriptions, and hints at future content.

narrativeProgression.description: Observation of the missing background image.
Solution to the missing background image issue.
Successful demonstration of the portable build.

Kodi application opened from the desktop shortcut, displaying the build correctly.

Quick cut to the "Browse for image" window.
